grammarFocus: 过去进行时入门；when / while；who / which / that 定语从句入门。
title: The Lantern Festival Storyteller
instructions: 本材料为模拟练习，非官方雅思试题。听录音前先阅读题目，听两遍后作答。填空题答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过字数限制。判断题选择True/False/Not Given，并参考解析中的原文证据。
transcript: Last year, I went to a small town in China for the Lantern Festival. I was walking along the river when I saw a crowd around an old man. He was telling stories about the festival. While he was speaking, people were listening quietly. The old man, who was wearing a red coat, said, "The Lantern Festival is on the 15th day of the first lunar month." He told a story about a clever girl who saved her village with lanterns. The story was one that everyone loved. While he was telling it, a little boy was holding a rabbit lantern. The boy's mother, who was standing next to me, smiled. I asked her, "Is this your first time here?" She said, "No, we come every year. My son loves the stories." Then the old man said, "Now, who can answer my question?" A girl raised her hand and said, "The festival ends with dragon dances." The old man laughed and gave her a small lantern. After the storytelling, I walked to the river and saw people putting lanterns on the water. It was a beautiful night.

grammar.title: 过去进行时与定语从句入门
grammar.explanation: 过去进行时表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，结构为was/were + 动词-ing。常与when/while连用：when引导短暂动作，while引导持续动作。定语从句用who指人，which指物，that指人或物，放在名词后补充信息。
grammar.example: I was walking along the river when I saw a crowd around an old man.

options: She was reading a book when I called her.
She were reading a book when I called her.
She was read a book when I called her.
She reading a book when I called her.
answers: She was reading a book when I called her.
questions.explanation: 主语She是第三人称单数，过去进行时用was + 动词-ing，因此A正确。
questions.evidence: She was reading a book when I called her.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The man ___ is wearing a red coat is my uncle.
questions.explanation: 先行词the man指人，定语从句用who引导。
questions.evidence: The man who is wearing a red coat is my uncle.

options: While I was cooking, the phone rang.
While I cooked, the phone was ringing.
While I was cooking, the phone was ring.
While I cook, the phone rang.
answers: While I was cooking, the phone rang.
questions.explanation: while引导持续动作，用过去进行时；主句用一般过去时表示突然发生的动作。
questions.evidence: While I was cooking, the phone rang.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The book ___ I bought yesterday is very interesting.
questions.explanation: 先行词the book指物，定语从句用which引导。
questions.evidence: The book which I bought yesterday is very interesting.
